rule.statement: A person who bases their title in prescriptive possession must show clear and unequivocal evidence that their possession was hostile to the real owner and amounted to a denial of their title to the property.
rule.supporting_quote: The principle of law is well established that a person who bases his title in adverse possession must show by clear and unequivocal evidence that his possession was hostile to the real owner and amounted to a denial of his title to the property claimed.
